Fortinet.title: Linux kernel RCE CVE-2026-98432
Fortinet.summary: CVSSv3 Score: 9.8 CVE-2026-98432:ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it.
